snippet.title: May 21st Morning Devotional, Go & Bless the World
snippet.description:
We are excited to have our week of prayer and fasting. Today (May 21st) is day 6 of our week and we are looking at Genesis 12:1. Mary Chopin one of our members will be encouraging us. Subscribe to get updates every morning this week!

We will have live streamed prayer meetings Monday-Friday at 6pm and Saturday at 9am.

For more information and resources go to jubileestl.org/fasting.
